idea-plugin.name: Legacy Autoload Mapping
idea-plugin.description:
Legacy Autoload Mapping teaches PhpStorm to validate PHP classes that use deterministic legacy class-to-file conventions the IDE does not understand natively.

Configure project source roots and declarative class/file patterns for conventions such as PSR-0 and PEAR underscore paths, Zend Framework 1, Doctrine 1, class suffixes, filename prefixes, and reusable case transformations.

The plugin works with global PHP classes, requires neither namespaces nor Composer autoload configuration, and provides refactoring-based quick fixes for mismatches.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.2.1

  • Warn when PhpStorm's built-in PSR-0/PSR-4 inspection may conflict with legacy mappings.
  • Open the official inspection directly or disable it safely in a project inspection profile.
  • Improve spacing and alignment in the project settings UI.
